scope: TA30-34 local original visual and official provenance review only

items.visual_observations: Complete narrow front with both mounting ears, ten visible tray fronts arranged in two rows of five, orange releases and right status/control strip. Several NVMe marks readable at native size. No obvious clipping; source is 966x88 and fine text cannot be treated as full-size engineering evidence.
items.technical_boundary: Front tray appearance/source model verified; no assertion that all trays contain installed drives or that the generic legacy sled is this OEM machine.

items.visual_observations: Complete compact front with twelve rectangular tray fronts in three rows of four, orange tabs and side ears. Native 400x70 is visibly coarse; small markings cannot be read reliably. No GPU boards/chips visible; no obvious truncation.
items.technical_boundary: Official definition is a parent chassis for SYS-620BT with four node bays and twelve HDD module bays. This image and historical filename do not certify a GPU-equipped server. Preserve it as source chassis front; scaling does not create a high-resolution native master.

items.visual_observations: Full front including both ears, broad upper honeycomb grille, two round release/handle details and four narrow orange-tab front trays in the bottom row. Right status strip retained; no obvious clipping. Its model name is not evidence that twelve trays are visible on the front.
items.technical_boundary: Source storage-server identity verified. Only four front tray faces are visible; internal media count/configuration and installed media are not inferred.

items.visual_observations: Complete graphic elevation with rack ears and four mount holes, three banks of sixteen main RJ45-like openings (48 total), separate 49-52 marked group, right auxiliary ports/status and Supermicro mark. Black openings and thin numbering are integral source art, not empty/corrupt regions. No obvious clipped port row.
items.technical_boundary: NetBox definition identifies Ethernet switch with swp1-48 1000base-t and swp49-52 10gbase-x-sfpp; these are recorded source-device properties, not a speed/deployment claim for the generic scene. TOR is a contextual role.

items.visual_observations: Full SN2100/Mellanox-marked front photograph, sixteen numbered large cages in two rows of eight, two auxiliary right-hand sockets, lower-left mini connector and left blue status strip. Native proportions are compact/half-width in character. No obvious clipping or missing numbered cage; do not stretch to the full rack width.
items.technical_boundary: NVIDIA/Mellanox product brief explicitly identifies SN2100 as an Open Ethernet switch. Library has 16 Ethernet QSFP28 interfaces. The image path uses mellanox-sn2100 while definition filename is MSN2100-CB2F; do not manufacture a SN2100.yaml path or infer IB from local filename. Photograph alone does not prove exact suffix, airflow variant or installed speed.

methods.local_pixels: All five local PNGs actually displayed through view_image original; no analysis crop or generated substitute used.
methods.byte_origin: Local SHA256 retained. Recomputed SHA1(blob header + original bytes) equals official directory API Git blob SHA for each five file, plus equal byte length. This verifies byte identity without remote media retrieval.
methods.official_text_fallback: web.run GitHub individual files returned cache misses; public GitHub connector then successfully read the five YAMLs, license and directory metadata. Failed URL attempts are not counted as sources read.

findings.finding: SN2100 is Ethernet. Historical switch_ib filename cannot appear as an InfiniBand technical claim. Source identity must say Ethernet/SN2100 or generic high-speed Ethernet context.
Source is a four-node parent chassis front with twelve visible drive tray fronts; not a visible GPU board or proof of GPU configuration.
400x70 original is low resolution. Use actual original size/aspect and explicit source limits; do not upscale and call it a new native high-resolution master.

Original images themselves have no obvious material truncation discovered. Existing source-to-Box aspect mismatch remains a separate future display issue from the prior static preflight; no product rendering was performed here.

Actual AS-1114S-WN10RT definition uses .yml, not .yaml. SN2100 definition is MSN2100-CB2F.yaml, but original PNG is mellanox-sn2100.front.png. Exact source paths were independently read rather than generated solely from guessed model names.
